guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 碧山—宏茂橋公園讓河川與公園共享空間；學徒需同時追蹤洪水佔用、河岸侵蝕、生態棲地與晴天活動，不把草地一律視為永久乾燥。
guides.conceptEn: Bishan–Ang Mo Kio Park shares space between river and park; learners track flood occupation, erosion, habitat and dry-weather use without assuming lawns stay permanently dry.
procedure: 先點選「上游集水與公園入口」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把C降成0.50，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 150 m³。與基準 225 m³比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「公園可淹水區」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把出流提高到0.8 m³/s，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 4320 m³。與基準 5040 m³比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「土壤入滲試驗區」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把f降成4 mm/h，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2 m³/h。與基準 5 m³/h比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「彎曲河道通洪」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把 n 改成0.020，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 5.450337 m³/s。與基準 7.267115 m³/s比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「河岸生物工程抗蝕」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把S增加到0.002，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 11.772 Pa。與基準 5.886 Pa比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「河岸廊道連續性」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把有效寬度減成8 m，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 6400 m²。與基準 9600 m²比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「棲地監測樣帶」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把分布改成四類各0.25，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.75 index。與基準 0.7 index比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「樹冠與活動區熱暴露」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把遮蔭比例提高至0.80，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 33.6 kW。與基準 25.2 kW比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「水位警示資料品質」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把樣品原讀值改成16.2，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 15.4 sensor unit。與基準 13.4 sensor unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「修復成效與對照河段」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把對照地事後值改成27，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 -1 indicator unit。與基準 -2 indicator unit比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
procedureEn: Select the upstream catchment and park entry measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only C to0.50 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 150 m³. Compare with baseline 225 m³ and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the floodable park zones measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only outflow to0.8 m³/s with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 4320 m³. Compare with baseline 5040 m³ and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the soil-infiltration trial plots measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only f to4 mm/h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2 m³/h. Compare with baseline 5 m³/h and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the meandering-channel conveyance measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only n to0.020 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 5.450337 m³/s. Compare with baseline 7.267115 m³/s and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the bioengineered-bank erosion resistance measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only S to0.002 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 11.772 Pa. Compare with baseline 5.886 Pa and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the riparian-corridor continuity measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only effective width to8 m with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 6400 m². Compare with baseline 9600 m² and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the habitat monitoring transects measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only proportions to four equal0.25 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.75 index. Compare with baseline 0.7 index and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the canopy and recreation heat exposure measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only shade reduction to0.80 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 33.6 kW. Compare with baseline 25.2 kW and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the level-warning data quality measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only raw sample to16.2 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 15.4 sensor unit. Compare with baseline 13.4 sensor unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the restoration outcomes and control reach measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only control-after to27 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute -1 indicator unit. Compare with baseline -2 indicator unit and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.
evidence: 畫屋頂、路面與綠地分區，分別加權C並核對雨量站。在離線場景為「上游集水與公園入口」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
以五分鐘資料逐步積分，再與水位—容積曲線核對。在離線場景為「公園可淹水區」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
多位置入滲試驗並記錄前期濕度，檢查溢流路徑。在離線場景為「土壤入滲試驗區」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
量測縱坡與斷面，校準不同水位的流量曲線。在離線場景為「彎曲河道通洪」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
比較洪後沖淤剖面與植被存活，不只採用一張乾季照片。在離線場景為「河岸生物工程抗蝕」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
在地圖標斷點，搭配定點觀察確認指定物種是否實際使用。在離線場景為「河岸廊道連續性」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
固定樣區、季節與採樣時長，另記棲地連續性與外來種。在離線場景為「棲地監測樣帶」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
同時量測陰陽面表面溫度、輻射與風，採相同時段對照。在離線場景為「樹冠與活動區熱暴露」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
用第二標準獨立驗證校正後殘差並記錄日期與溫度。在離線場景為「水位警示資料品質」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
採同期多日資料並檢查前期趨勢，不選只對結果有利的一天。在離線場景為「修復成效與對照河段」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
evidenceEn: Map roofs, pavement and vegetation, weight C separately and check rainfall data. Build an offline evidence table for upstream catchment and park entry; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
Integrate five-minute data and compare with the stage-storage curve. Build an offline evidence table for floodable park zones; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Test infiltration at several positions, record antecedent moisture and inspect overflow routes. Build an offline evidence table for soil-infiltration trial plots; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Measure slope and section and calibrate the discharge curve at several depths. Build an offline evidence table for meandering-channel conveyance; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Compare post-flood erosion profiles and plant survival rather than one dry-season photograph. Build an offline evidence table for bioengineered-bank erosion resistance; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Map breaks and use fixed observations to verify use by specified species. Build an offline evidence table for riparian-corridor continuity; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Fix plots, season and effort and separately record connectivity and invasive species. Build an offline evidence table for habitat monitoring transects; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Measure shaded/unshaded surface temperature, radiation and wind concurrently. Build an offline evidence table for canopy and recreation heat exposure; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Use a second standard to verify corrected residuals independently and record date and temperature. Build an offline evidence table for level-warning data quality; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Use simultaneous multi-day data, inspect pre-trends and avoid selecting a favorable day. Build an offline evidence table for restoration outcomes and control reach; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
pitfalls: 把mm直接乘m²而未除1000會造成千倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
水位計零點漂移會看似增加儲量，需獨立水尺確認。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
表面細砂堵塞會讓原設計入滲值失效。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
沉積與生物膜改變粗糙度，沿用初建值可能高估能力。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
彎道外側局部沖刷可遠高於平均值。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
廊道被道路切斷時，相同面積仍可能失去連通。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
採樣努力量增加會製造看似改善，須對照基線。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
只用紅外線表面溫度宣稱人體降溫會混淆指標。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
以同一標準建立又驗證模型會隱藏校正偏差。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
處理地同時換交通流量會讓單一干預歸因失真。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
pitfallsEn: Multiplying mm bym² without dividing by1000 gives a thousandfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Level-sensor zero drift can mimic storage gain; confirm with an independent staff gauge. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Fine-sediment surface clogging invalidates the original infiltration estimate. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Sediment and biofilm alter roughness; an as-built value may overestimate capacity. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Outer-bend local scour can greatly exceed the mean. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
A road break can destroy connectivity despite unchanged area. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Greater sampling effort can mimic improvement; compare with the baseline. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Claiming human cooling from infrared surface temperature alone confuses indicators. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Calibrating and validating with the same standard hides bias. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Concurrent traffic changes at the treated site confound attribution. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

guides.scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

related.why: 比較兩個系統的物質或能量收支，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare material or energy balances and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 設備尺度、進料組成與品質目標必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Equipment scale, feed composition and quality objectives require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.
